channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Desliga-TSE: Tribunal realiza teste de infraestrutura com desligamento da internet
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will conduct a controlled internet shutdown test on Friday, June 24, from 9h to 22h, to simulate emergency infrastructure conditions ahead of the 2026 elections. The exercise will temporarily disable online services and VPN access for remote workers, affecting both in-person and telecommuting staff, as well as regional electoral courts' access to the TSE Portal. The goal is to assess operational resilience and identify technical vulnerabilities before the upcoming electoral period.

item.title: Cleitinho deve anunciar no sábado sua candidatura ao governo de Minas
item.description: Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos-MG) is expected to announce his candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais on Saturday (July 25, 2026), following a delay due to his brother's death. His entry into the race is expected to strengthen alliances with PL, União Brasil, PP, and Republicanos, including a deal to support Senate candidates and Flávio Bolsonaro for president, in exchange for Jair Bolsonaro's backing. This could isolate Governor Zema's preferred successor, Vice Governor Matheus Simões (PSD), in the center-right camp.

item.title: “Agora é esperar as cenas dos próximos capítulos”, diz irmão de Michelle
item.description: Eduardo Torres, brother of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, commented on the reconciliation between Michelle and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) after the senator's public apology, stating that what matters is that they sit down, talk, and move forward together for the right-wing cause in the country. Torres attended the recording of Michelle's video response and later posted a message on social media emphasizing the importance of healing, learning, and growing together. He is a pre-candidate for district deputy under the PL party.

item.title: Eduardo repete Flávio e diz que TSE usa urnas Smartmatic
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro repeated his brother Flávio Bolsonaro's claim that the TSE uses Smartmatic voting machines in Brazilian elections, despite the electoral court denying the use of Smartmatic urns or software and stating that the electronic voting system is developed internally by Brazil's Electoral Justice. Flávio had previously made the same accusation at an event with diplomats, citing CIA reports on vulnerabilities in Venezuela's voting systems and asserting that the same machines are used in Brazil. The statements were criticized by other politicians, including Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado, who called them damaging to Brazil's international image and a missed opportunity to promote national interests.

item.title: PF vê crime em Dark Horse e complica Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating suspected money laundering and foreign exchange evasion tied to the financing of the film Dark Horse, involving over R$61 million that allegedly flowed from Entre Investimentos to a Texas-based fund and then to Go Up Entertainment in Brazil. The probe challenges Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s claim that the transaction was a private commercial deal, given evidence he directly requested funding from Daniel Vorcaro. Approved by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça and backed by the PGR, the investigation comes at a pivotal moment in Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-campaign, as he struggles to regain momentum amid family rifts and weak support from key political and business sectors.

item.title: Se Flávio não queria prestar serviços à empresa que recebeu dinheiro do Master, por que emitiu nota?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro issued R$1.5 million in invoices to companies linked to Rogério Lourenço Novo, who was previously investigated for issuing fake invoices, despite claiming he did not want to work for Copenhagen, another firm in the same group. Carlos Andreazza questions the logic of issuing invoices if no work was intended, noting two were canceled and one remained, while Bolsonaro received R$500k from someone tied to the Banco Master scheme. The columnist argues this pattern of associations is causing political wear and radicalizing his discourse.

item.title: Entre direito e literatura, Cármen Lúcia defende 'constitucionalismo de pirraça' na Flip 2026: 'Arte é transgressão'
item.description: Justice Cármen Lúcia promoted a 'constitutionalism of tantrum' at Flip 2026 while launching her book 'By the Hand of the People: Vote and Democracy in Brazil', emphasizing the inviolability of electronic voting machines and the importance of popular participation in democracy. She criticized the disconnect between Brasília and the populace, described voting as an act of individual autonomy, and dismissed concerns raised by Flávio Bolsonaro about electoral integrity, stating that Brazilians have already accepted the system.

item.title: Retrospectiva: deputados aprovaram minirreforma eleitoral no primeiro semestre deste ano
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a 2026 electoral mini-reform that caps fines for disapproved party or candidate accounts at R$30,000, bans the seizure or blocking of Party Fund and Special Campaign Financing Fund resources by courts (except for proven misuse), and allows automated electoral messaging to officially registered phone numbers, with providers prohibited from blocking such numbers unless ordered by a court. Additionally, a bill was passed preventing condominiums from prohibiting rental of units to political parties for use as party headquarters, provided the tenant notifies the landlord in advance.

item.title: MP é contra liminar que tirou guarda do filho de Karina Kufa, casada com Brennand
item.description: São Paulo's Public Prosecutor's Office opposed a court order that removed custody of Karina Kufa's son from her, citing that her marriage to imprisoned and convicted Thiago Brennand does not, by itself, constitute a concrete risk to the child. The 12th Family Court upheld the order, citing potential harm from disrupting the child's routine. Amilton Augusto da Silva Júnior, the child's father and a state deputy pre-candidate, married to federal deputy pre-candidate Val Marchiori, argued the child faces social stigma and that Brennand is a weapons enthusiast.

item.title: Trivia pode perder concessão se não cumprir contrato, diz Tarcísio
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas threatened to terminate the contract with Trivia Trens, operator of CPTM Lines 11-Coral, 12-Safira and 13-Jade, after a train fire forced passengers to walk on tracks at Tatuapé station. He stated that if the company fails to meet contractual obligations, sanctions will be applied and the concession may be declared forfeited, with temporary state operation foreseen under contractual protections modeled after the privatization of Lines 8-Diamond and 9-Emerald.

item.title: EUA confirmam taxa de 12,5% para o Brasil, que iniciará trâmites da Lei de Reciprocidade
item.description: The United States will impose an additional 12.5% tariff on Brazilian products starting Friday (July 24), adding to the existing 25% tariffs already applied to nearly one-fifth of Brazil's exports. In response, the Brazilian government will initiate procedures next week to invoke the Reciprocity Law in Camex and file consultations at the WTO, though sources say no retaliation will occur before the October elections.

item.title: Bastidores: Michelle e Flávio usaram pontes para gravar vídeo de pacificação; clima ainda não é bom
item.description: The reconciliation video between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro was crafted through intermediaries — including Rogério Marinho, Celina Leão, and Valdemar Costa Neto — without direct contact, highlighting ongoing tension. Despite its lack of spontaneity, the gesture comes just two days before the PL national convention confirming Flávio’s presidential pre-candidacy and constitutes a significant political gain amid new allegations and an STF-authorized PF investigation into the Dark Horse film funding case.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro sela paz com Flávio após pedido de desculpas: ‘Todos nós cometemos erros’
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro accepted the apology of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) after a public disagreement over Ceará candidates, stating that 'we all make mistakes' and pledging to work with him in the October elections to unite the right. She praised his sincerity and courage, and thanked Damares Alves and Celina Leão for supporting the reconciliation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Careca do INSS contrataram o mesmo contador
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and pre-candidate for President, hired the same accounting firm used by Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes, known as 'Careca do INSS,' who is identified as a central operator in a scheme of undue deductions from social security benefits. The revelation, based on fiscal documents from Flávio Bolsonaro Sociedade Individual, raises suspicions about possible links between the legislator and illicit practices in the pension sector.

item.title: Michelle aceita pedido de desculpa de Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accepted the apology from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after he posted a video lamenting their family disagreement. In response, Michelle thanked him for his sincerity and suggested they meet to discuss strategies aimed at 'gathering a great army of good people to rescue our Brazil,' in the name of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Dá para votar sem biometria? Como método vai funcionar nas Eleições 2026
item.description: In the 2026 elections, biometrics will be used to identify voters, but the absence of registration or a failure in fingerprint reading will not prevent voting, according to the TSE. In such cases, voters may cast their ballot using a photo ID or identification by name and electoral zone, ensuring access to vote even without biometrics.

item.title: Bolsonaristas comemoram vídeo de desculpas de Flávio a Michelle: 'Pacificar é essencial para a vitória'
item.description: Bolsonarista lawmakers praised a video in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro apologized to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, acknowledging her leadership in PL Mulher and inviting her to join his presidential campaign. Figures such as Sóstenes Cavalcante, Nikolas Ferreira, and Marcelo Queiroga emphasized the reconciliation as vital for unifying the political camp and securing victory in the 2026 elections. Michelle accepted the apology in a follow-up video, stating she received the message with peace and sincerity.

item.title: Tarcísio chama falha em trens de 'inaceitável' e promete punições em SP
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas called the train failure that paralyzed three lines 'unacceptable' and said the government will investigate responsibilities and apply the penalties provided for by law.

item.title: TSE divulga limites de contratação de pessoal para campanhas eleitorais
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has released the maximum limits for hiring personnel for street mobilization and militancy activities in the 2026 elections through Portaria nº 444/2026, signed by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques. The caps are scaled according to the size of each municipality’s electorate, based on the 2026 voter registry closure, and apply to both election rounds. The measure complies with the Election Law (Law nº 9.504/1997) and TSE Resolution nº 23.607/2019.

item.title: Michelle responde a Flávio, diz aceitar pedido de desculpas e abre caminho para união na campanha
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accepted Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's apology, praising his sincerity and calling for unity among the right to defeat the PT. She emphasized that reconciliation must be led by former President Jair Bolsonaro, currently under house arrest, and that together they must mobilize a 'great army of good people' to rescue Brazil.

item.title: ‘Arbitrário e injustificado’: Governo Lula reage ao novo tarifaço e volta a citar Lei de Reciprocidade
item.description: The Lula government rejected the new 12.5% U.S. tariff on Brazil, calling it arbitrary and unjustified, and announced it will invoke the Reciprocity Law and bring the case to the WTO. Combined with the previous 25% tariff, this results in a total duty of 37.5% on some Brazilian exports. The government emphasized Brazil’s strong labor rights record, noting it has ratified 66 ILO conventions compared to only 10 by the United States.

item.title: Michelle aceita desculpas de Flávio e fala em reunir exército para vencer as eleições
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accepted Flávio Bolsonaro's apology after he released a video expressing sincerity and acknowledging past mistakes. She said they are ready to talk, align details, and unite forces to build a 'great army of good people' for the 2026 elections, aiming to rebuild Brazil in honor of Jair Bolsonaro. The reconciliation was facilitated by Celina Leão and Damares Alves, following Michelle's June video in which she accused Flávio of mistreating her in a phone call.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz live após pedido de desculpas a Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a live broadcast shortly after releasing a video apologizing and requesting the support of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro for his 2026 presidential pre-campaign. During the stream, he reiterated claims of false accusations and political persecution, defending his legal work and private investments tied to the Dark Horse film about Jair Bolsonaro. Michelle Bolsonaro publicly responded by thanking him for the apology, indicating potential alignment in the campaign.

item.title: “Vamos fazer isso pelo meu marido e seu pai”, diz Michelle a Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accepted the apology made by her son-in-law, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, after a video was released on Thursday. She said she received his words with peace and thanked him for the initiative, emphasizing the need for unity amid political challenges. The former first lady reaffirmed her commitment to the family and the political legacy of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Michelle responde a vídeo de Flávio: 'Eu te desculpo'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro responded to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's appeal for support and an apology, stating she accepts and forgives him. The former first lady did not explicitly declare her candidacy, but the gesture reinforces familial ties within the Bolsonaro clan. The episode unfolds amid the 2026 presidential pre-campaign, as Flávio seeks to consolidate family backing for a potential presidential run.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro descredibiliza sistema eleitoral brasileiro em live com argentino indiciado no inquérito do golpe
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) questioned the integrity of Brazil's electoral system during a live stream with Argentine political consultant Fernando Cerimedo, who is indicted in the coup plot investigation, claiming electronic voting machines cannot be audited and linking criticism of the system to the January 8, 2023 events. He cited a 2022 Army report that, according to him, did not exempt the machines from vulnerabilities, despite the technical assessment finding no evidence of fraud.

item.title: Falha em trens reacende disputa Tarcísio e Haddad
item.description: An explosion on a train in the Brás region of central São Paulo on Thursday morning paralyzed lines 11-Coral, 12-Safira, and 13-Jade, forcing passengers to walk along the tracks using cellphone lights for guidance. The incident marks the third consecutive failure since Trivia Trens took over operations, reigniting a political dispute between Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Fernando Haddad over the management and privatization of São Paulo's metropolitan rail system.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio realiza live após pedir desculpas a Michelle
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) held a live stream at 7 p.m. on Thursday, July 23, 2026, after apologizing to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, with whom he had recent tensions. During the broadcast, he called for unity among the right-wing in the 2026 elections, reinforcing his status as a presidential pre-candidate. The live was promoted on his social media with an invitation to watch in real time.

item.title: Aliados de Lula exploram investigação de dinheiro de Vorcaro a 'Dark Horse' para atacar Flávio
item.description: Allies of President Lula have politically exploited the authorization by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça for the PF to investigate the 'Dark Horse' case, using it as grounds to attack Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on social media. The move aims to leverage the investigation to damage the pre-candidate's image.

item.title: Governo Lula reage a nova tarifa dos EUA e promete acionar reciprocidade
item.description: The Lula government rejected the additional 12.5% tariff imposed by the U.S. on Brazilian products, calling it arbitrary and based on unfounded accusations of forced labor, and announced it will immediately invoke the Reciprocity Law to retaliate, potentially raising U.S. tariffs on Brazil to as high as 37.5%.

item.title: Michelle responde a Flávio: 'Aceito seu pedido. Eu te desculpo'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accepted the public apology of her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, following a dispute over the PL party's stance in Ceará. She stated that his gesture showed sincerity and that she may now engage in his presidential campaign, emphasizing their shared purpose for the good of the people and for Jair Bolsonaro. Michelle also thanked Governor Celina Leão and Senator Damares Alves for facilitating the reconciliation.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro posta vídeo em resposta a Flávio: 'Eu te desculpo, vamos conversar'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accepted a public apology from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, her former stepson, after a month of social media silence due to a family rift. In an Instagram video, she stated they share the same goal of working for Brazil's good and announced plans to meet to finalize their reconciliation and unite in defending Jair Bolsonaro's legacy.

item.title: Governo Lula diz que EUA “manipulam” para sobretaxar Brasil
item.description: The Lula government accused the U.S. of manipulating the issue of forced labor to justify additional 12.5% tariffs on Brazil and 58 countries, noting the U.S. has ratified only 1 of 4 ILO conventions on forced labor, while Brazil ratified all. Brazil said it will pursue action at the WTO and use reciprocity mechanisms under its law, but remain at the negotiating table, as Lula stated, despite the lack of reciprocity in talks with the Trump administration.

item.title: Haddad será lançado em São Paulo com acenos ao eleitor de centro e anúncio de suplentes
item.description: Fernando Haddad will be officially nominated as the PT's pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo at a convention in Campinas this Saturday, aiming to consolidate a broad alliance with appeals to center voters and the Paulista interior. The event will also announce Senate substitute candidates and reaffirm the strategy of nationalizing the campaign, seeking to surpass his 2022 performance and strengthen support for Lula in Brazil's largest electoral college.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro vai apoiar candidatura de Flávio em novo vídeo
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) will publicly endorse her brother-in-law, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), for President of Brazil in a video to be released in the coming hours. The endorsement reinforces the family alliance within the PL party and signals a strategy to mobilize the Bolsonarist base ahead of the 2026 elections. The statement comes amid growing polarization and internal dispute over the legacy of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: 'Estou aqui para confundir': União Brasil é condenado a pagar indenização a filho de Chacrinha após uso do bordão
item.description: União Brasil was ordered to pay R$20,000 in damages for using Chacrinha's catchphrase 'I am here to confuse, not to explain' and his image in political propaganda without authorization. The Rio de Janeiro court ruled this violated copyright and image rights of the late entertainer, whose sole heir, Leleco Barbosa, filed the lawsuit. The party is banned from further use of Chacrinha's likeness and slogans and says it is reviewing the decision for possible appeal.

item.title: ‘Apenas mais um resmungo’, diz Cármen Lúcia sobre novos questionamentos às urnas eletrônicas; vídeo
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia dismissed recent challenges to Brazil's electronic voting machines as 'just another grumble,' saying they will have less impact than in 2022. She emphasized her past leadership at the TSE and expressed full confidence in the electoral system's security and transparency, noting accessibility improvements. Speaking at Flip, she responded to claims by Flávio Bolsonaro, who linked Brazilian machines to alleged Venezuelan fraud — a claim rejected by the TSE.

item.title: Mendonça autoriza PF a investigar repasses de Vorcaro para cinebiografia de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the Federal Police to investigate R$ 61 million in transfers from former banker Daniel Vorcaro to the film 'Dark Horse,' a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro. The probe examines whether the funds were used to cover expenses for former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro in the U.S. or exchanged for favors from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who denies any wrongdoing.

item.title: “O recado do Flávio é fundamental: focar no inimigo”, diz Nikolas
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) praised Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's video in which he publicly apologized to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, stating the gesture serves as a message to the militant base to focus on their common enemy. He emphasized that pacification is essential for victory and that Flávio's message reinforces the need for unity against adversaries.

item.title: Governo rechaça nova tarifa, diz que EUA manipularam 'tema caro aos direitos humanos' e volta a falar em reciprocidade
item.description: The Lula government rejected the U.S. imposition of up to 12.5% additional tariffs on Brazilian goods, accusing Washington of manipulating the issue of forced labor to justify protectionist measures without legal basis. Brazil emphasized its ratification of 66 ILO conventions and strong domestic laws against forced labor, contrasting with the U.S., which has ratified only 10. The government reiterated its threat to invoke the Law of Reciprocity in response.

item.title: Michelle grava vídeo após Flávio se desculpar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro posted a video on social media apologizing to Michelle Bolsonaro, after which she responded with her own video. The exchange occurred amid political speculation involving the Bolsonaro family. The full article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Em resposta a Lula, EUA dizem ter interesse em eleições do Brasil
item.description: The U.S. State Department said it has an interest in Brazil’s democratic process, responding to President Lula’s challenge to Secretary Marco Rubio to form a committee supporting Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid. Lula had declared he would defeat all opponents in defense of democracy and invited international observers, including Americans, to monitor the elections. U.S.-Brazil tensions have intensified due to new tariffs, the designation of criminal groups as terrorists, and reciprocal criticisms between Lula and Rubio.

item.title: Trem na disputa em SP: após pane, Haddad fala em 'rever concessão' e Tarcísio em possível perda de contrato, embora 'problema não tenha começado agora'
item.description: Following disruptions and an explosion on CPTM lines concessioned to Trivia Trens, pre-candidate Fernando Haddad (PT) criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' management, stating he would review concession contracts if elected, including those for Sabesp, CPTM, and the Administrative Center. Tarcísio responded that the company may face sanctions for non-compliance but emphasized the issues did not start three days ago, noting that management would temporarily revert to CPTM for 90 days.

item.title: A condição que Michelle Bolsonaro impôs para fazer as pazes com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro set as a condition for reconciliation with Flávio Bolsonaro that the gesture of rapprochement must come from her stepson, according to discussions held last week. She demanded that he take the initiative, as revealed in an exclusive article for subscribers.

item.title: Ligação de Alexandre Frota ao vivo gera suspeita de contato com Bolsonaro
item.description: A live call made by Alexandre Frota during the TMC podcast sparked suspicions that he had contacted Jair Bolsonaro, who is currently under house arrest with bans on cell phone and social media use. Frota did not disclose who was on the other end, nor did the podcast hosts, but social media users claimed to recognize Bolsonaro's voice. STF-imposed restrictions prohibit Bolsonaro from using any external communication means, directly or through third parties.

item.title: Mendonça trata Flávio com rigor que assombra os bolsonaristas
item.description: André Mendonça, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro to the Supreme Federal Court on the grounds that the tribunal needed a 'terribly evangelical' minister, took a strict stance against Flávio Bolsonaro on Thursday. His decision was seen as a significant setback for the senator and his bolsonarist allies, who viewed Mendonça’s move as a betrayal of expected loyalty. The phrase 'served Flávio Bolsonaro the bread that the Tinhoso kneaded' implies he is now facing the consequences of his own actions — a metaphor for poetic justice.

item.title: Republicanos cobra reciprocidade do PL para fechar aliança com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Republicans demand reciprocity from the PL to form a national alliance with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race, claiming the PL did not support Republican gubernatorial candidates in exchange. The party says it has chances to elect governors in six states, including São Paulo and Minas Gerais, and views the alliance as strategic to secure first-round victories in Mato Grosso and Roraima, while boosting PL senators. Without concessions, the Republicans threaten to remain nationally neutral and ruled out supporting Lula.

item.title: EUA anunciam sobretaxa de 12,5% sobre produtos brasileiros
item.description: The United States announced a 12.5% surtax on Brazilian products, which, when added to the previous 25% tariff, results in a total tariff of 37.5% effective July 24, 2026. The measure is based on a Section 301 trade investigation that concluded Brazil failed to ban imports of goods made with forced labor. In addition to Brazil, 59 other countries were targeted, including Argentina, China, Canada, and the European Union.

item.title: Novo lançará Zema à Presidência no Edifício Íon, em Brasília
item.description: The New Party will hold its national convention on Monday, July 27, 2026, at the Íon Building in Brasília to officially nominate Romeu Zema as its presidential candidate. The event will be hybrid, with national president Eduardo Ribeiro attending in person and other leaders joining virtually. The vice-presidential candidate will be announced later, before the August 5 deadline, with Geraldo Rufino (Podemos) and Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) mentioned as possibilities, though she has ruled out joining the ticket.

item.title: Em meio a divergências, PSDB-Cidadania apoiará reeleição de Tarcísio
item.description: The PSDB-Cidadania Federation announced its support for the re-election of São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) in a statement released on Thursday, July 23, a decision to be ratified at the state convention on July 28. The support follows internal party divisions, where a faction had proposed a candidacy with former senator José Aníbal, but it was dismissed as an isolated move. The federation will also launch a major Senate candidacy, with Soninha Francine as one of its pre-candidates, reaffirming its commitment to unity and strengthening a political project for the state.
